user.title: Home Signals
user.description: Pick the entities the activity feed should watch, then tell Needs you where to look. Every Needs you field is optional — leave one empty and that check simply contributes nothing.

data.done_lists: To-do lists that keep a "done today" record

data.ignore_unavailable: Never report these (offline or low battery)
data.salt_both_threshold: Alert when every side is at or below (%)
data.salt_one_threshold: Alert when any one side is at or below (%)
data.security_locks: Locks that must be locked (empty means all)
data.security_openings: Door and window contacts that must be closed
